rationale: Price has been locked at $20.00 for the last five consecutive 1-minute candles with essentially no range, indicating a complete stall with no directional momentum to exploit. The ATR is extremely compressed ($0.017) relative to the spread, meaning any move needed to reach a meaningful take-profit would require multiple ATRs of travel in only 17 minutes before forced liquidation. With the stock pinned at a round-number level and no breakout signal in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
